q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app for Example Notes. However, Linux users can access all their notes through any modern web browser. Note that the web app requires an internet connection, so offline access isn't available on Linux.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Unfortunately, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later, so it is not supported on Android 11. You may be able to use the web app in a modern mobile browser as a workaround.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: Unfortunately, no — the web app requires an active internet connection to work. However, the mobile and desktop apps support offline use and will sync automatically once you're back online.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to **Settings > Export**, then choose **PDF** as your format. Your notes will be exported and emailed to you as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: No worries — your note is still recoverable! Open the **Trash** section in the app, find your note, and click **"Restore"**. Deleted notes are kept in Trash for **30 days**, so you have plenty of time.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, SMS is not supported for two-factor authentication in Example Notes. You can enable 2FA by going to **Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication** and using an authenticator app instead.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, the maximum attachment size is **25 MB per file**. If you need larger attachments (up to 250 MB), you can upgrade to the Plus or Team plan.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you won't lose access immediately. When you cancel, you keep all Plus features until the end of your current billing period. To cancel, go to **Settings > Billing > Cancel plan**.
